classification: complete child/signing, bridge, and natural-symmetry enumeration; interval child-pressure comparison; numerical transcendental and linear-algebra evaluation
field_frame_metric: The left metric is |<u_1,B1>|/||B1|| and the right metric is |<v_1,B^T1>|/||B^T1||. Leading-vector claims are also reported after requiring relative singular gap >0.05, avoiding tie-only falsification.
fixed_frame_metric: For G=MM^T, c_left=||A G-G A||_F/(2||A||_op||G||_F); c_right is the analogous quantity for M^T M and the right child. Zero is necessary for preservation of the child spectral subspaces.
natural_symmetry_quotient_definition: Simultaneous signed child similarities with common multiplier delta, acting on B with multiplier delta, together with global B negation. Orbit counts are exact Burnside counts.

scope.certified_finite_input: thermal minimizers are selected by exhaustive signing and exact energy-histogram enumeration, with interval-separated partition-sum comparisons
scope.complete_finite_enumeration: every bridge is included in q_lambda and every natural signed symmetry is included in the Burnside quotient
